chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Mahziyar, from his father, from his grandfather Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Makhramah ibn Rib'i, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "The 'bank of the river on the right' which Allah, the Exalted, mentioned in the Quran is the Euphrates, and the 'blessed spot' is Karbala."

key_terms.شَاطِئِ الْوَادِ الْأَيْمَنِ: The bank of the river on the right

ai.seo_question: Which Quranic locations are identified as the Euphrates and Karbala in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explicitly identifies the 'bank of the river on the right' (shatī' al-wādī al-ayman) from Surah Tā Hā as the Euphrates and the 'blessed spot' (al-buqʿah al-mubārakah) as Karbala, establishing a direct geographical link between Quranic verses and Shia sacred sites. This interpretation is foundational in Shia tafsir for validating the spiritual merit of Karbala and the Euphrates, reinforcing their status as places of divine blessing and prayer.
